title: Statistical Estimation of higher Dedekind Numbers
summary: We provide highly accurate estimations of the 10th through 15th Dedekind Numbers, to a precision of 4 digits for $D(10)$, to 2 digits for $D(15)$. These estimates were obtained using three methods, including pair matching on large quantities of 9-dimensional monotone Boolean functions for $D(10)$, Reference Subsets for $D(10)$, $D(11)$, and $D(12)$. And our best method "Weight Layer Branching" which provided accurate estimates for all $D(10)$ through $D(15)$, strongly improving on the previous best known estimates by Korshunov and Tian-Shun Chen et al. arXiv:2606.09795
